security.title: Security
security.desc: A second step when you sign in
security.sso_note: If you sign in with a provider such as Authelia, this step is not needed: the provider does it.
security.row.totp_desc: A code that changes every 30 seconds
security.row.email_desc: We email you a code each time you sign in
security.row.codes_none: Available once a method is on
security.need_key: The authenticator app needs NUTREEK_SECRET_KEY on this server.
security.need_mail: The email code needs email set up on this server.
security.totp.step1_text: With Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password or another app.
security.totp.qr_label: QR code for the authenticator app
security.totp.key_label: Can't scan it? Type this key:
